The image shows three separate components, with no reaction arrows or plus signs. They are best written as one multi-component SMILES, with the parts separated by dots.

1. 4-Benzyloxyphenylacetaldehyde: O=CCc1ccc(OCc2ccccc2)cc1
2. N-Methylallylamine: C=CCNC
3. 4-Ethynylanisole: C#Cc1ccc(OC)cc1

All three are drawn with plain bonds and have no stereocentres, so no stereo marks are needed.

SMILES: O=CCc1ccc(OCc2ccccc2)cc1.C=CCNC.C#Cc1ccc(OC)cc1
